title: Smart Questions to Ask in an SRE Interview
summary: Four questions a candidate can ask at the end of an SRE job interview: the biggest reliability challenge, shared ownership, service standards, and what a great first year looks like.

sentences.text: What is our biggest reliability challenge right now, and what does success look like in six months?

chunks.en: What is our biggest reliability challenge
chunks.ko: 우리의 가장 큰 안정성 과제는 무엇인가요

chunks.en: and what does success look like

sentences.tip: reliability는 re-li-A-bi-li-ty, 셋째 음절 A에 힘을 줘요. like in은 '라이킨'처럼 붙여 말해요.

sentences.text: How do teams share ownership here?
sentences.tip: share ownership는 r 소리를 다음 모음에 붙여 '셰어로운어십'처럼 이어요.

sentences.text: For example, who owns the SLOs?
sentences.tip: SLOs는 S-L-Os로 글자를 하나씩 읽고, 마지막 O에 힘을 줘요.

sentences.text: How mature are our service standards today—like tracing, SLOs, and incident reviews?

chunks.en: How mature are our service standards
today—like tracing, SLOs, and incident reviews?
chunks.ko: 지금, 예컨대 트레이싱, SLO, 장애 회고 같은 것들은

sentences.tip: mature are our는 '머추어라아워'처럼 이어 말해요. 줄표(—) 자리에서 잠깐 쉬고 예를 나열해요.

sentences.text: For the first SRE hire, what does a great first year look like to you?

chunks.en: what does a great first year

sentences.tip: SRE는 S-R-E로 읽고 마지막 E에 힘을 줘요. 끝의 to you는 가볍고 빠르게.

questions.q: What time frame does the speaker ask about for success?
questions.why: 1번째 문장: what does success look like in six months?

questions.q: What example does the speaker give when asking about shared ownership?
questions.why: 3번째 문장: For example, who owns the SLOs?

questions.q: Which service standards does the speaker mention?
questions.why: 4번째 문장: like tracing, SLOs, and incident reviews

questions.q: Who is most likely asking these questions?
options: A candidate interviewing for the first SRE role
questions.why: 5번째 문장: 첫 SRE 채용 자리에 대해 면접관에게 묻고 있어요.

vocab.note: 서비스가 장애 없이 꾸준히 동작하는 정도. SRE의 핵심 단어예요.
한 팀이 아니라 여러 팀이 같이 맡는다는 뜻.
Service Level Objective. 예: 응답의 99.9%가 300ms 안에.
How mature is ~? = ~가 얼마나 자리 잡혔나요?
장애 뒤 원인과 개선점을 함께 돌아보는 회의.
What does success look like? = 성공은 어떤 모습인가요?
